# Nianae
Nianae, also known as moths due to their resemblance to the earth insect, are a species of large, bipedal invertebrates hailing from the verdant, jungle planet of Jaldar. They have adapted to their planet's chilly and radioactive atmosphere by evolving a thick fuzz around their neck. They possess a pair of antennas on top of their head as well as a large set of wings on their back.
## Racial Features - They can eat cotton, fabrics and clothing, but virtually none of the food that others would consider "edible". - Their blood is [color=#ffa500]copper[/color] based, thus being metabolised from it. - Their blood has a sickly green color. - Their wings give them [color=#1e90ff]50% more acceleration in 0 gravity[/color]. - They are able to jump short distances, allowing them to move around quickly. They can jump up to [color=yellow]3[/color] times in a row, and will regain one 'charge' every [color=yellow]30[/color] seconds. - Due to their thick fuzz they take [color=#1e90ff]30% less Cold damage[/color] and [color=#ffa500]20% more Heat damage. - Additionally their fuzz offers them significant radiation protection, resulting in [color=#1e90ff]50% less radiation damage[/color]. - Their fists deal [color=red]5[/color] blunt damage with unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they [color=#1e90ff]can withstand temperatures between -45 and 45 degrees Celcius[/color]. - They take [color=#ffa500]350% damage from being set on fire and catch on fire easier[/color]. - They take [color=#1e90ff]50% less cold damage from freezing[/color] and [color=#ffa500]100% more damage from overheating[/color].
## Moffic The Nianae language, known as moffic, is composed of a series of chitters. It is often described as sharp and incomprehensible, unable to be spoken by the majority of species without great difficulty. Additionally, Nianae are able to understand mothroaches as they communicate in a similar way to Nianae infants.
## Age and Names Nianae have a slightly shorter lifespan compared to that of humans, reaching adulthood at around 5 years of age and living up to 130. Nianae names are given to them upon reaching adulthood, as they are not consider sentient before then, by their caretakers and commonly include references to fire, light or stars.
